AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 50 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crop.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

16. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Tools and Equipment 3.2 Product Processing and Value Addition 3.3 Establishing A and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Product Processing and Value Addition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Establishing Agricultural Enterprise 3.4 Marketing Agricultural Produce 3.5 Comp and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Establishing Agricultural Enterprise and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing Agricultural Produce 3.5 Composting Techniques Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
